concerns.text: T024 instructs to 'assert statistical significance (p < 0.05)' but does not specify the statistical test method (e.g., two-sided t-test) or how to generate the null model's distribution. The spec (SC-002) requires a specific test, but the task lacks the concrete steps to execute it deterministically.

T030 instructs to 're-run importance excluding one if flagged' but does not explicitly require re-training the model to verify performance stability (RMSE). The spec (US-3, Scenario 3) requires verifying model performance stability, not just recalculating importance scores. The task is ambiguous on the deliverable (re-trained model vs. new scores).

T031 defines a sensitivity analysis sweeping thresholds {50, 100, 150} K/s but fails to define the binarization logic required to calculate F1 (if applicable). The spec (SC-003) has conditional logic (F1 < 10% if binarized) that the task does not resolve, leaving the implementer unsure whether to calculate RMSE or F1 for these thresholds.

T001 'Create project structure per implementation plan' is too coarse. It covers an entire phase of setup without naming specific files or directories to create. The atomizer will need to split this into individual file-creation tasks.

T034 'Add README.md with execution instructions' is too coarse. It does not specify the exact content sections (e.g., 'Prerequisites', 'Data Ingestion Command', 'Training Command') or the specific scripts to document, making the deliverable vague.
